content.title: Stock Of The Day Holds Above Buy Points As GE Supplier's Markets 'Only Get Stronger'
content.summary: Shares of Carpenter Technology rallied above important price levels this week as the industrial metals supplier, the IBD Stock of the Day, benefits from demand for jet engines and other markets.  Although Carpenter Technology serves multiple industries, 64% of the company's sales (excluding a raw materials surcharge) comes from its aerospace business.  With an 11% year-over-year increase, it was the company's best-performing segment in the September-ended quarter and helped offset declines in other markets.
